The '''Subterranean Power Station''' was a [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]] located on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. The power station was [[Raid on Kessan's Landing|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] of the [[Hidden Chain]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TtLO" />
